projectionContract: Explicit semantic projection of the complete immutable diagnostic summaries. Pressure retains all entered/cleared denominators, zero counts, totals, P50/P95/max and conditional sample counts; mean/P90 and duplicated nested counts omitted. All80control keys/configs/outcomes/reasons/sources, all240variant paired outcomes/durations/harms/slowdowns plus individual late-pressure measures, all36naturalendless outcomes/carry/Boss observations remain. Full RunResult payloads and largeplans remain ignored/archive. No byte-equality claim to source; retain source SHA and this projection SHA separately.
